description: Angular component for a widget action dialog in the Thingsboard platform, managing widget actions including form handling, validation, and UI logic.

classes.name: WidgetActionDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for widget action dialog, handling form initialization, validation, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets up reactive subscriptions for form controls.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and submits the form data, then closes the dialog with the result.

methods.name: displayShowWidgetActionForm
methods.description: Determines if the show widget action form should be displayed based on data.

methods.name: getWidgetActionFunctionHelpId
methods.description: Returns help ID string based on action source.

methods.name: updateShowWidgetActionForm
methods.description: Updates validators for show widget action function based on current form state.

methods.name: checkColumnIndex
methods.description: Validates and adjusts the column index value.

methods.name: getCellClickColumnsInfo
methods.description: Fetches and processes cell click column info.

methods.name: validateActionName
methods.description: Returns a validator function to ensure action name uniqueness.

methods.name: checkActionName
methods.description: Checks if the action name is unique within its source.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state.

methods.name: actionSourceName
methods.description: Returns a translated name for an action source.

methods.name: getCellClickColumnInfo
methods.description: Returns formatted string for cell click column info.
